result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, the same order the sales rep's list uses.

The change is one line in `DataStore.java`: `findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion` (around line 5277) now calls `.highestPriorityFirst()` on its query, and its Javadoc says so. Closed tickets and other regions are still excluded, since only the sort was added.

`RegionManagerTest` (5 tests) and `ClosedTicketsTest` (2 tests) pass offline. I did not run `SupportTicketServiceTest`, because no test class by that name exists in the repo. Nothing is committed.
